ecom_store_manager.name: Store Manager
ecom_store_manager.description: Runs the store: catalog, pricing, orders, shipments, returns, stock, and tills.

ecom_warehouse_operator.name: Warehouse Operator
ecom_warehouse_operator.description: Ships orders, moves and counts stock. Can look up orders and the catalog but cannot change prices or refund.

ecom_cashier.name: Cashier
ecom_cashier.description: Sells and refunds at the till and runs the till session. Can look up the catalog and stock.

ecom_catalog_editor.name: Catalog Editor
ecom_catalog_editor.description: Maintains products, variants, categories, collections, storefront content, and reviews. Cannot change prices, discounts, orders, or stock.

ecom_pricing_officer.name: Pricing Officer
ecom_pricing_officer.description: Sets pricing rules, discounts, customer groups, and tax zones. Can look up the catalog and shipping zones but cannot change them.

ecom_order_manager.name: Order Manager
ecom_order_manager.description: Runs web orders through shipment and return. Can look up the catalog, stock, and the buyer trail but cannot change prices or stock rows.

ecom_customer_support.name: Customer Support
ecom_customer_support.description: Handles return requests and reviews. Can look up orders, shipments, the catalog, and the buyer trail but cannot refund an order or change the catalog.

ecom_pos_supervisor.name: POS Supervisor
ecom_pos_supervisor.description: Configures tills, payment methods, and fiscal devices, and can sell at the till. Can look up the catalog and stock.

ecom_analyst.name: Store Analyst
ecom_analyst.description: Read-only access across the catalog, orders, stock, tills, and buyer records. Cannot change anything.
